product: Investigations Made Easy v1 (Mac App Store)
note: Machine-readable release gates (App Store completion instructions 2026-10-30 §1.7, §9, §14). Run `bash scripts/release-check.sh [--candidate <sha>]`. A `command` gate runs and must exit 0. An `evidence` gate needs the named file, free of placeholders, naming the candidate commit. A `human` gate needs a retained approval record at release/approvals/<id>.md written by the responsible person (fields: Decision, By, Role, Date, Commit) — the check never creates one. Missing evidence is OPEN; a required skip is not a pass. Exit code is non-zero unless every required gate is PASS.
